name: Black Death
description: 'Father abandoned child, wife husband, one brother another; for this illness seemed to strike through the breath and sight. And so they died... great pits were dug and piled deep with the multitude of dead... And as soon as those ditches were filled, more were dug... And so many died that all believed it was the end of the world.'

name: Colonial Revolution
description:
The ideas of the [ShowInstitutionName('enlightenment')] have found a receptive audience in colonial holdings around the world. The ruling elite in the colonies, deprived of political involvement, have been inspired the ideals of liberty, equality, and representation. Naturally, these ideas clash with their current status as a subject to their colonial overlords, existing only to satisfy the demands of their masters.

Either through political pressure or outright revolt, it will be difficult to maintain order in the colonial landscape for a long time.

name: Columbian Exchange
description: Contact with new foreign peoples from beyond the sea has opened our country to novel crops and animals from these faraway lands, and has brought great opportunities to develop trade relationships that provide our merchants access to strange and exotic new products.

name: Council of Trent
description: Based in [ShowLocationName('trento')], the $council_of_trent$ is the [ShowReligionAdjective('catholic')] attempt to stop [ShowSituationName('reformation')] and to overhaul the laws and policies of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('catholic_church').GetName]. During this period, major reforms can be proposed by any member of the Church, though in the end the real power — if such debates come to fruition — remains in the hands of the [ShowSpecialStatusName('curia')] and the [GetCountry('PAP').GetLongName].

name: Fall of Delhi
description: A century of overextension and a crumbling central authority have hurt the rule and reputation of the mighty [GetCountry('DLH').GetName]. Beyond their borders are vultures and enemies, waiting to strike at any moment. The great [GetCountry('DLH').GetFlavorRank] of their forefathers will be brought to its knees in but an instant lest they succeed in safeguarding their people from internal and external threats.

name: Golden Age of Piracy
description: The wealth of the New World has attracted more than great empires to its waters — an unending tide of brigands and disgruntled sailors has also embarked, more than willing to follow the call of adventure, treasure, and freedom... even if they risk ending their escapades dangling from a noose.

name: Great Pestilence
description: Terrible news reaches us from abroad. Misery and plague sweep the land, and death runs with them, apparently brought by mysterious bearded foreigners. This plague is not something our elders have ever heard of, and no answers in our ancestors' memories could help us face the catastrophe if it reaches our settlements. Will our people perish, or will we somehow resist when this walking death reaches us?

name: Guelphs and Ghibellines
description: The [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('guelphs_io').GetName] and [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('ghibellines_io').GetName] have been fighting for dominance over [ShowRegionName('italy_region')] for centuries, ever since the Investiture Controversy pitted the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('catholic_church').GetLeaderTitle] and the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetLeaderTitle] against each other. The [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('guelphs_io').GetNameWithNoTooltip] support the [GetCountry('PAP').GetAdjective] authority over the peninsula, while [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('ghibellines_io').GetNameWithNoTooltip] are considered Imperial loyalists holding their allegiance true to the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName]. But matters have spiraled well beyond their initial positions, and both sides now represent a diversity of interests; the different countries are no strangers to switching sides when doing so might benefit them.

name: Hundred Years' War
description: The death of the last direct heir to the [GetCountry('FRA').GetAdjective] throne has left a power vacuum, plunging [ShowRegionName('france_region')] into turmoil. With competing claims and long-standing tensions over territory and feudal rights, the fragile peace between [GetCountry('FRA').GetNameWithNoTooltip] and [GetCountry('ENG').GetNameWithNoTooltip] has shattered. Both realms hold lands across [ShowRegionNameWithNoTooltip('france_region')], creating friction that threatens the unity of [ShowReligionGroupName('christian')]. What began as a dispute over succession has escalated into a protracted struggle for dominance — one that now threatens to scar the continent for generations.

name: Hussite Wars
description: A series of conflicts between the followers of [ShowReligionName('hussite')] and [ShowReligionName('catholic')], it quickly escalated into a full-blown war for the very identity of the country itself.

name: Italian Wars
description:
For over a century, [ShowRegionName('italy_region')] has prospered thanks to her advantageous position in [ShowContinentName('europe')]. Thriving foreign trade, abundant wealth, and the flowering culture of the [ShowInstitutionName('renaissance')] have ushered in a golden age in many parts of the peninsula.

However, this prosperity has attracted the attention of outside powers, who slaver over [ShowRegionNameWithNoTooltip('italy_region')]'s riches and seek to usurp control of her smaller independent states. In response, the strongest powers in [ShowRegionNameWithNoTooltip('italy_region')] have united in leagues in an effort to repel the invaders...

name: Little Ice Age
description: The bone-chilling cold of the Little Ice Age tests our resilience, forcing our leader to adapt or watch their domain descend into frozen hell. Whether through careful governance or sheer survival instinct, history will remember those who make it through this time of great hardship.

name: Nanbokuchō Jidai
description: Following the dismantling of the Kamakura Shogunate, Imperial rule was reinstated under [GetCharacter('jap_go_daigo_tenno').GetName] with the help of [GetCharacter('jap_ashikaga_takauji').GetName] in what is known as the Kenmu Restoration. However, the two former allies quickly became bitter rivals. [GetCharacter('jap_go_daigo_tenno').GetNameWithNoTooltip] wanted to restore the supremacy of the Imperial rule like it was in the Heian Period, which earned [GetCharacter('jap_go_daigo_tenno').GetHerHim] the discontent of many in the warrior class, including [GetCharacter('jap_ashikaga_takauji').GetNameWithNoTooltip]. The latter was pushed out from the capital and forced to flee to Kyūshū, but was able to return to [ShowLocationName('kyoto')] in 1336 and seize it, establishing a new [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('japanese_shogunate').GetName] under [GetCharacter('jap_ashikaga_takauji').GetHerHim] and enthroning a new Emperor. In January 1337, [GetCharacter('jap_go_daigo_tenno').GetNameWithNoTooltip] fled the capital and established [GetCharacter('jap_go_daigo_tenno').GetHerHis] own court at [ShowLocationName('yoshino')], starting the period known as $nanbokuchou$, the Northern and Southern Courts.

name: Red Turban Rebellions
description: The [ShowCultureGroupName('chinese_group')] are revolting against their [GetCountry('CHI').GetCulture.GetName] overlords. The rebels have declared the establishment of their independent states, throwing the entirety of [GetCountry('CHI').GetName] into a civil war that threatens to devour the $YUA$ dynasty...

name: The Reformation
description:
'#italic When our Lord and Master Jesus Christ said 'Repent,' he willed the entire life of believers to be one of repentance.#!'

These were the first notes in a document of 95 Theses found nailed to a church door, each detailing the corruption of the [GetInternationalOrganization('catholic_church').GetName]. Having suffered an extended period of weakness and internal struggle, the [ShowReligionAdjective('catholic')] faith seems ripe for reform. Many echo the same sentiment as the author of the 95 Theses about the pureness of internal faith, and that only through God can a [ShowReligionGroupAdjective('christian')] can experience forgiveness. Others decry this work as heresy and straying disturbingly far from the [ShowReligionAdjectiveWithNoTooltip('catholic')] beliefs.

With a wave of discussion sweeping [ShowContinentName('europe')], it has become clear that this will irreversible alter the future of our continent.

name: Rise of the Turks
description:
Driven by a potent combination of ambition, martial skill, and strategic vision, many [ShowCultureName('turkish_culture')] Beyliks carved their own paths through the fragmented realms of [ShowRegionName('anatolia_region')]. Their nomadic origins merged with the sophistication of settled societies, creating a formidable blend of military might and administrative acumen.

As the regional principalities lay divided and vulnerable, the most formidable among them seized the opportunity to unite their ranks under a single banner. Charismatic leaders such as [GetCharacter('tur_osman').GetName], the founder of [GetCountry('TUR').GetName], ignited flames of inspiration that would burn brightly for centuries to come.

With every victory, these Beyliks gather momentum, transforming themselves into a force to be reckoned with. The conquest of vital towns and cities across the region all heralded their inexorable rise.

name: Rise of $name_timur$
description: Fueled by the ambition to follow in the steps of $genghis_khan_name$ and Caliphs, [GetCountry('TIM').MakeScope.GetVariable('tim_founding_father').GetCharacter.GetName] rallied [GetCountry('TIM').MakeScope.GetVariable('tim_founding_father').GetCharacter.GetHerHis] soldiers and loyalists, and founded a nascent Empire built on ruthless expansion and brilliant tactics. To [GetCountry('TIM').MakeScope.GetVariable('tim_founding_father').GetCharacter.GetNameWithNoTooltip], the lands of [ShowSubContinentName('central_asia')], [ShowSubContinentName('middle_east')], and $india$ are the ripest for [GetCountry('TIM').MakeScope.GetVariable('tim_founding_father').GetCharacter.GetHerHis] conquest, which will indelibly shape these regions over the coming centuries...

name: Sengoku Jidai
description: It is a time of upheaval. The central authority of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('japanese_shogunate').GetLeaderTitle] has waned, and [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('japanese_shogunate').GetLeaderCountry.GetGovernment.GetRuler.GetHerHis] power to control the different clans diminished. Fueled by their own conflicts, the clans have increased their autonomy and independence, and have become masters of their own territory. Japan will be engulfed in war unless someone is powerful enough to grab the reins of government once again...

name: People's Uprising
description: Wealth inequality, a declining standard of living, and increased literacy have led to the rise of individual awareness. The ongoing exploitation of the lower classes by the nobility, along with the unchecked power of the ruling class, has finally driven both our burghers and the peasantry to demand a change in government. This new movement challenges the established order of society, which for as long as we can recall has seen a dominant upper class oppress those below them.

name: Treaty of [GetSituationByKey('treaty_of_tordesillas').MakeScope.GetVariable('treaty_location').GetLocation.GetNameWithNoTooltip]
description: This treaty was signed in [GetSituationByKey('treaty_of_tordesillas').MakeScope.GetVariable('treaty_location').GetLocation.GetName] by the [GetSituationByKey('treaty_of_tordesillas').MakeScope.GetVariable('var_east_country').GetCountry.GetLongName] and the [GetSituationByKey('treaty_of_tordesillas').MakeScope.GetVariable('var_west_country').GetCountry.GetLongName]. $treaty_of_tordesillas_desc_second_section$

name: War of Religions
description: After several decades of religious strife, dissent over the correct practice of [ShowReligionGroupAdjective('christian')] worship in the [GetInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName] has reached a point where armed conflict between the [GetInternationalOrganizationType('protestant_union').GetName] and [GetInternationalOrganizationType('catholic_league').GetName] seems impossible to avoid. While these organizations of Imperial princes are mainly concerned with the protection of their respective faiths, many leaders in [ShowContinentName('europe')] look at the turbulent Empire with greedy eyes. Whether it be charged with religious fervor or worldly desire, the mightiest powers of [ShowContinentNameWithNoTooltip('europe')] are preparing their armies for a fight, as the peace of the Empire hangs in a delicate balance.

name: Western Schism
description: $western_schism.1.desc$
